move: four layered word copies glide in from four sides, parallax over video
how: A dark 1080 square with a muted background video scrubbed at quarter speed, a vignette, four overlaid copies of the word (outline, screen-blend red, italic cream, faint outline), a berry SVG and small captions. The copies slide in from x -700, x 700, y 300 and y -300 with opacity 0 (move, 1.4s) at 0%, 2%, 5% and 7% of the clip and land slightly offset from one another; from 28% they glide a few px in opposing directions over 3s (sine.inOut) for a parallax feel, while the berry crosses behind the italic layer from x -700 to 700 turning 70deg. Captions rise through masks. At 86% each copy leaves the way it came (expo.in, 0.06s apart) and the captions fly up.
adapt: Change the word, the four layer treatments (stroke, blend, italic), the video and captions; keep the 1.4s move entries with 0.12s offsets and the 3s sine.inOut glide.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the layers, berry and video, waiting for loadeddata; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline; the video-scrub tween is already an onUpdate tween setting currentTime and ports directly. Scope selectors to el.
caveats: background video currentTime is set from a tween and needs the video decoded before the first frame (fx.wait)
the video scrub and its scale 1.06 zoom do not return to frame 0 on loop
